description: Extract only printed values from the synthetic Contoso receipt. Never approve a purchase.

document_id.description: The complete document number, retaining its hyphens.

date.description: The issue date printed on the receipt.

currency.description: Normalize the document's Korean-won currency indication to KRW. Do not guess when absent.

quantity.description: Quantity in the single item row, not a monetary amount.

unit_price.description: The KRW price of one item, not the row or document total.

total.description: The final overall total printed on the document. Do not fill it by calculation.

approval_status.description: Use pending when the document says approval is pending, approved only when it explicitly says approved, or unknown when absent. Classify the printed state; never perform approval.
